zh: 这一版把「用键盘也能走完全程」补齐了：词库、练习、统计、我的各处的按钮、开关、下拉框和侧栏导航现在都能用 Tab 聚焦，回车或空格就能触发，聚焦时有一圈石青色的提示环，读屏软件也能正确读出它们的名字和开关状态。导入词库时按钮会转起小圈、暂时不再响应，免得重复点出两个文件选择器。桌面版的窗口标题栏里现在显示真实的版本号，不再是一个永远写着 0.0.0 的占位符。窄窗口的底部导航不再压住列表最后一行，切走再切回页面时滚动位置也留在原处。词库在宽屏下改成「词语｜释义」两列并排，表头与每一行严格对齐；练习页把「开始复习」提到了首屏，桌面左右分栏、手机上不用往下滚就能点。统计页和首页不再把同一个数字反复说好几遍，侧栏底部的装饰文字和图标也收拾干净了。快捷键帮助表按页面分组写清了真实按键，弹窗按 Esc 就能关掉；搜索框里输入 n 不会再误弹出新建词语页。删除词库现在会点名告诉你删掉了哪一个，批量删除用醒目的危险色，最后一个词库的删除按钮变成明确的不可点状态。
en: This release finishes the keyboard pass: buttons, switches, dropdowns and the sidebar/tab destinations across Words, Practice, Stats and Profile are now reachable with Tab, fire on Enter or Space, draw an azurite focus ring and expose their name and on/off state to screen readers. Importing a wordbook now shows an inline spinner and stops accepting taps, so a second file picker cannot stack on the first. The Windows window now reports the real version number instead of a placeholder 0.0.0. On narrow windows the bottom bar no longer covers the last list row, and scroll position survives switching away and back. The wordbook switches to a real two-column grid on wide screens with the header pixel-aligned to every row; the Practice page brings Start Review into the first screen — two columns on desktop, no scrolling needed on a phone. Stats and Home no longer restate the same figure several times, and the decorative text and icons in the sidebar bottom were tidied up. The shortcut sheet now groups the real bindings by page and closes with Esc; typing n into the search box no longer opens the new-word editor by accident. Deleting a wordbook now names the one you removed, bulk delete uses the destructive colour, and the delete control on the last remaining wordbook is clearly disabled.
